display_title: Update Database ERD Diagrams and OpenAPI Docs

head_commit.message:
[Issue #7731]: Allow individuals to apply to org-only competitions (#8476)

## Summary

Work for #7731 

## Changes proposed

- Removed `IneligibleStartApplicationModal`
- Disabled application submission on the apply page when:
  - the competition is **organization-only**, and
  - the application is currently **associated to an individual**
- Added a warning alert on the apply page with a link to transfer
application ownership


## Context
Organization-only opportunities previously blocked application creation
when no organization was associated. Because organization data may not
yet be available while SAM.gov synchronization is pending, this PR
allows users to start an application without an organization and defers
enforcement to submission time. The apply page now clearly communicates
the requirement and provides a transfer ownership path before
submission.

---

## Validation steps

APPLYING TO ORGANIZATION ONLY OPPORTUNITY
- log into application as user with two_org_user
- apply to an opportunity that only allows `Organizations`
  - search `Local Organization Only Opportunity`
  - start an application
- [ ] VERIFY: The Start Application Modal does error when you do not
select an organization
- [ ] VERIFY: That "I don't see my organization" is a selection option.
Choose this.
  - On Applications page:
    - [ ] VERIFY: The Submit Button is `IS DISABLED`
    - [ ] VERIFY: The Alert is `IS VISIBLE`
- [ ] VERIFY that the Transfer button `IS VISIBLE` in the information
card
- [ ] VERIFY that when said button is click, that it populates a the
Transfer Ownership Modal
- [ ] VERIFY that when transfer button is clicked from modal, and org is
selected, the add org endpoint is called
- [ ] VERIFY that once a transfer happens the button is NOT VISIBLE from
the applications page information card

---------

Co-authored-by: Erin Pattison <erinpattison@navapbc.com>
